value: hexa analyze 26.9.12 allows adapters/primary -> usecases imports (0 violations) though CLAUDE.md forbids it; import_policy sees external imports only. Enforce with a cargo test that reads src/adapters/primary. Also: one violation = 90 = grade A, so gate on --grade A+.

A real claude probe under a throwaway HOME hangs with no output on a Bedrock SSO profile: the AWS SDK looks for ~/.aws in the fake HOME. Symlink the real ~/.aws into it first (ln -s ~/.aws $FAKE_HOME/.aws).

When injecting a bug and restoring the file from a backup made before the injection, the restored file is OLDER than the injected build, so cargo keeps the buggy build: the next test run fails (or passes) against code that is not in the tree. Restore by writing the content fresh, or touch the file after restoring.
